description: Fix Coder Desktop OpenRouter model picker overlap and z-order in apps/coder-desktop/page.coax and App.swift.

steps.send: Fix the OpenRouter model picker overlap and z-order bug (#13724) in `apps/coder-desktop/page.coax` and `apps/coder-desktop/App.swift`: ensure the model picker dropdown renders above composer/conversation elements without overlapping the OpenRouter entry, and passes `coax/bin/coax test apps/coder-desktop/page.coax --only model` and `swiftc -parse apps/coder-desktop/App.swift`.

graders.run: grep -q "!s\[0\]\.model_menu" apps/coder-desktop/page.coax && swiftc -parse apps/coder-desktop/App.swift && coax/bin/coax test apps/coder-desktop/page.coax --only "model picker"
